subject.title: fix(agents): let swarm collector fan-outs honor group caps

question: Should Labs-enabled collector children be exempt from `agents.defaults.subagents.maxChildrenPerAgent` and be governed solely by the configured Swarm group caps?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility change to an existing admission limit, not only a mechanical correction; the linked report itself identifies several viable cap-ownership policies.

options.title: Adopt Swarm-owned collector caps
options.body: Confirm the documented split so collector children use only Swarm group caps while announce children continue using the per-session cap.

options.title: Retain the session cap
options.body: Keep collector children within the generic per-session cap and revise or close this branch because the existing safety limit remains authoritative.

recommendation.title: Adopt Swarm-owned collector caps
recommendation.body: Confirm the documented split so collector children use only Swarm group caps while announce children continue using the per-session cap.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the supplied Swarm design and the targeted cap-conflict proposal, making them the clearest available routing candidate for the intended semantics.
